_comment: Bundles a minimal (probes, cenr) tuple for _build_probe_set so the
byte-stability guard in TestInv1ByteStability can pin every emit shape
produced by the shape-based dispatcher without depending on the
(a) vpn-bag host, no observation                -> bare fqdn / reachability
(b) vpn-bag host, observed UDP/500              -> bare fqdn / reachability (bag wins)
(c) vpn-bag host with '-vpn.' name, no obs      -> bare fqdn / reachability
(d) proxy-bag host, observed TCP/443            -> https://host / application
(e) proxy-bag host, observed TCP/8080           -> host:8080  / application
